paragraphs.text: The Lotus Vale was a garden on Tolaria in which Black Lotuses were grown. It was tended by the wizards of the Tolarian Academy , led by Barrin . It was destroyed, along with the rest of Tolaria, when Barrin obliterated the island during the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .
↑ Pete Venters (October 1997). "Dominian Chronicles: Weatherlight Ports of Call." The Duelist #19, 33-34
